required_structure.provenance: owner's hard-structure list for the gym; each measure is a function over the compiled catalog (features.py)

lookalike_relations_rate.provenance: design parameter: share of schemas required to hold a look-alike relation pair

entities_per_model.provenance: design parameter: instances of a labelled model per world; sized so a world stays under one planner prompt

records_per_model.provenance: design parameter: instances of an unlabelled model per world

pool_size.provenance: design parameter: invented values requested per property

same_name_rate.provenance: design parameter: chance a speaker model gets two entities sharing a label

supersede_rate.provenance: design parameter: share of validity-bound records a later source restates

tombstone_rate.provenance: design parameter: share of records hidden by a tombstone decision

null_rate.provenance: design parameter: chance an optional property is left unrecorded

max_hops.provenance: design parameter: longest chain in a plan

plan_mix.provenance: design parameter: relative share of plan kinds before fidelity discards

questions_per_world.provenance: design parameter: verified plans kept per world before rendering

sources_per_world.provenance: design parameter: publications a world's statements are spread over

relations_probe_limit.provenance: design parameter: filter candidates tried against the engine per plan
